# Colaberry AI

> Colaberry AI is an enterprise platform for discovering, evaluating, governing, and deploying AI agents, MCP server integrations, reusable skills, and industry use cases — with production-ready audit trails and compliance built in.

## What is Colaberry AI?

Colaberry AI helps enterprise teams ship AI programs with confidence. The platform provides a curated catalog of AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integrations, composable skills, and structured use cases — all with governance metadata, lifecycle status tracking, and deployment readiness signals. Supporting resources include podcasts, articles, books, white papers, and case studies.

## Who is it for?

- **AI/ML engineering teams** evaluating agents and integrations for production workloads
- **Enterprise architects** building governed AI delivery pipelines
- **Business leaders** assessing AI use cases with measurable ROI outcomes
- **Data & analytics teams** connecting agents to existing business applications via MCP

## Core capabilities

### Agent Catalog (/aixcelerator/agents)
Browse production-ready AI agents with structured metadata: lifecycle status (live/beta/concept), visibility controls, source attribution (internal/external/partner), industry alignment, core tasks, input/output specs, orchestration patterns, tool dependencies, and security compliance. Each agent has a dedicated profile page at `/aixcelerator/agents/[slug]`.

### MCP Server Integrations (/aixcelerator/mcp)
Pre-built Model Context Protocol server connectors for business applications, data sources, and developer platforms. Metadata includes capabilities, authentication methods, hosting options, compatibility matrix, pricing, and interactive demos. Detail pages at `/aixcelerator/mcp/[slug]`.

### Skills Library (/aixcelerator/skills)
Reusable AI capabilities that plug into agents and workflows. Categorized by family (pre-built toolkits, developer tools, domain operations, orchestration). Includes provider attribution, model compatibility, prerequisites, and linked agents/MCP servers/use cases. Detail pages at `/aixcelerator/skills/[slug]`.

### Use Cases (/use-cases)
Structured business scenarios with problem statements, solution approaches, quantified outcomes, implementation steps, and linked agents/skills. Designed for decision-makers evaluating AI ROI. Detail pages at `/use-cases/[slug]`.

### Resources
- **Podcasts** (/resources/podcasts): Audio episodes with full transcripts, timestamps, company tags, and platform links (Apple, Spotify, YouTube). Detail pages at `/resources/podcasts/[slug]`.
- **Articles** (/resources/articles): Editorial content with rich text, author attribution, and categories. Detail pages at `/resources/articles/[slug]`.
- **Books** (/resources/books): Enterprise reference material and delivery frameworks.
- **White Papers** (/resources/white-papers): Technical guidance, reference architectures, and governance frameworks.
- **Case Studies** (/resources/case-studies): Outcome-driven stories with client context, challenges, solutions, and measurable results.

## Machine-readable data

- `/sitemap.xml` — Dynamic sitemap with all published content URLs and lastmod timestamps
- `/robots.txt` — Crawling directives for search engines and AI crawlers
- `/llms-full.txt` — Complete content index with summaries for every catalog item
- All detail pages include Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Article, PodcastEpisode, HowTo, BreadcrumbList)
- All pages include Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags

## Frequently asked questions

**Q: What industries does Colaberry AI serve?**
A: Agriculture, Energy & Utilities, Healthcare, Climate Tech, Manufacturing, Fintech, and Supply Chain. Each industry has a dedicated workspace at `/industries/[industry]` with curated agents, use cases, and resources.

**Q: How are agents evaluated for production readiness?**
A: Each agent carries lifecycle status (live, beta, or concept), security compliance metadata, verified badges, usage metrics, and community ratings. Enterprise teams can filter by readiness level before deployment.

**Q: What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?**
A: MCP is a standard for connecting AI agents to external business applications, data sources, and APIs. Colaberry AI catalogs MCP server implementations with authentication readiness, hosting options, and compatibility details.

**Q: How can I try the platform?**
A: Visit `/request-demo` to schedule a conversation with the team, or use the `/assistant` discovery interface to explore the catalog interactively.

**Q: Is content available via API?**
A: Content is managed via Strapi CMS with REST API. All catalog pages support filtering by industry, status, source, visibility, and tags. Sorting options include trending (engagement-weighted), latest, and alphabetical.

- **AIXcelerator** — The core platform surface for agent delivery and governance

- **MCP Server** — A Model Context Protocol integration connector
- **Skill** — A reusable AI capability that composes into agents and workflows
- **Use Case** — A structured business scenario with measurable outcomes
